title: Background task accessing closed DB session after response sent
content: When using BackgroundTasks with SQLAlchemy, the DB session from Depends(get_db) is closed after the response is sent. Background tasks must create their own session via SessionLocal() instead of reusing the request-scoped session.

title: Depends() with yield does not run cleanup in BackgroundTasks
content: If a dependency uses yield (for cleanup like closing DB), the cleanup runs BEFORE the background task executes. Background tasks cannot rely on yield-based dependencies for resource management.

title: Global mutable state shared across requests in async endpoints
content: Module-level mutable variables (lists, dicts) are shared across all concurrent requests in async mode. This causes race conditions. Use request.state or dependency injection for per-request state.

title: Depends cache returns same instance for same arguments within one request
content: FastAPI caches dependency results per-request by default. If you need a fresh instance each time, use Depends(get_db, use_cache=False). This commonly causes issues with multiple DB operations expecting separate sessions.

title: Sync def endpoint blocks the entire event loop under load
content: A synchronous endpoint (def instead of async def) runs in a threadpool, but the threadpool has limited workers (default 40). CPU-intensive sync endpoints under high concurrency exhaust the pool, blocking all other requests including async ones.

title: Calling sync database library inside async def causes event loop blocking
content: Using synchronous DB drivers (psycopg2, sqlite3) directly inside async def blocks the event loop. Must use async drivers (asyncpg, databases) or wrap sync calls in run_in_executor().

title: StreamingResponse with sync generator blocks event loop
content: Using a regular generator (def) with StreamingResponse in an async endpoint blocks the event loop during iteration. Must use async generator (async def) or run_in_executor for file reads.

title: asyncio.sleep vs time.sleep in async endpoints
content: time.sleep() blocks the event loop, preventing other requests from being processed. Always use await asyncio.sleep() in async endpoints. Even 0.1 second sleep blocks ALL concurrent requests.

title: response_model with ORM objects causes infinite recursion on circular references
content: SQLAlchemy models with bidirectional relationships (user.posts ↔ post.author) cause infinite serialization when used directly as response_model. Must define Pydantic schemas with explicit fields to break cycles.

title: Pydantic V2 model_validator mode='before' breaks FastAPI request parsing
content: In Pydantic V2, using @model_validator(mode='before') on request body models can receive raw dict or model instance depending on context. Validation logic must handle both cases.

title: Optional fields with None default still require field in JSON body
content: Pydantic V2 distinguishes between field not provided vs field set to None. Use Field(default=None) explicitly. Omitting a field in request JSON may raise validation error if not properly configured with Optional.

title: response_model_exclude_unset removes fields that were explicitly set to their default value
content: When using response_model_exclude_unset=True, fields explicitly set to their default value are excluded from response. This surprises when you want to return status='pending' (the default) explicitly.

title: CORSMiddleware must be added AFTER all route definitions or it does not work
content: CORS middleware must be the last middleware added (first to process requests). If added before other middleware or before mounting sub-applications, preflight OPTIONS requests may not be handled correctly.

title: Middleware ordering is reversed - last added middleware executes first
content: FastAPI/Starlette middleware stack is LIFO (last in, first out). The last app.add_middleware() call creates the outermost layer. Authentication middleware must be added AFTER CORS middleware to work correctly.

title: Uvicorn workers do not share in-memory state between processes
content: When running with multiple uvicorn workers (--workers N), each worker is a separate process. In-memory caches, rate limiters, and session stores are NOT shared. Must use external store (Redis) for shared state.

title: Exception handlers do not catch HTTPException from dependencies
content: Custom exception handlers registered with @app.exception_handler only catch exceptions from route handlers. HTTPException raised in Depends() functions bypass custom handlers and use FastAPI default.

title: OAuth2 scopes not automatically enforced - must check in each endpoint
content: Declaring Security(oauth2_scheme, scopes=['admin']) does NOT automatically reject requests missing the scope. You must manually check security_scopes.scopes in the dependency and raise HTTPException.

title: JWT decode without audience verification allows token from other services
content: When decoding JWT with python-jose or PyJWT, skipping audience (aud) claim verification means tokens issued for Service A work on Service B. Always set audience parameter in jwt.decode().

title: HTTPBearer returns 403 instead of 401 for missing token causing auth flow issues
content: FastAPI's HTTPBearer security scheme returns 403 Forbidden when no token is provided, not 401 Unauthorized. This breaks OAuth2 refresh flows that expect 401 to trigger token renewal.

title: File upload UploadFile must be consumed before response or data is lost
content: UploadFile content is a SpooledTemporaryFile that gets garbage collected after the request handler returns. If you pass UploadFile to a background task without reading it first, the file content is empty.
